## Jesus in Islam (peace be upon him)

Muslims love and honour Jesus, ʿĪsā ibn Maryam ("Jesus, son of Mary"), as one of the greatest messengers of God. A Muslim cannot be a Muslim without believing in him. The Quran mentions him by name 25 times and calls him the Messiah (al-Masīḥ), "a word from Him" and "a soul from Him" (Quran 3:45, 4:171).

### His mother, Mary

- God chose Mary, purified her and chose her "above the women of the worlds" (Quran 3:42).
- A whole chapter of the Quran, Surah Maryam, is named after her, and another, Āl ʿImrān, after her family.

### A miraculous birth

- Jesus was born to Mary without a father. "The example of Jesus to Allah is like that of Adam": God said "Be," and he was (Quran 3:59).
- As a newborn, he spoke from the cradle to defend his mother: "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet" (Quran 19:30).

### His message

- He was sent to the Children of Israel, confirming the Torah, and God gave him the Gospel (Injīl), "guidance and light" (Quran 3:49, 5:46).
- He called people to "worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord" (Quran 5:117).
- His disciples answered his call: "We have believed in Allah and testify that we are Muslims [submitting to Him]" (Quran 3:52).

### His miracles, by God's permission

- He formed a bird from clay, breathed into it and it became a bird.
- He healed the blind and the leper, and brought the dead back to life (Quran 3:49, 5:110).

### A human messenger, not God

- "The Messiah, son of Mary, was not but a messenger." He and his mother "both used to eat food" (Quran 5:75).
- On the Day of Judgment, Jesus will say he never told people to worship him or his mother (Quran 5:116–117).

### The cross

- The Quran says: "They did not kill him, nor did they crucify him; but [another] was made to resemble him to them." Rather, "Allah raised him to Himself" (Quran 4:157–158).

### His return

- Muslims believe Jesus will come back before the Day of Judgment, as a just ruler who brings peace and justice and defeats the False Messiah (reported in Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim).

### Jesus and Muhammad

- Jesus gave good news of "a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad" (Quran 61:6).
- Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: "I am the closest of people to Jesus, son of Mary… the prophets are brothers… their religion is one" (Sahih al-Bukhari 3442–3443).

This is why Muslims always say "peace be upon him" after his name: to follow Islam is to follow the same message Jesus brought.
